title: Semantic validation record for a recognized official evaluator artifact
description: Describes how build-english-core-repro-manifest.py inspected one --official-evidence artifact. Unrecognized artifact kinds are byte-hashed only and are reported with semanticValidation.status = "unrecognized"; they are never semantically approved or rejected on guessed grounds.

version.description: Version of the semantic-validation contract that produced this record. Consumers must refuse to merge records from an unknown version.

kind.description: Recognized official evaluator family, or null when the artifact shape matched no supported family.

checks.description: Deterministic check outcomes in evaluation order. Empty when status is unrecognized.

id.description: Stable check suffix, appended to the artifact label to form a promotion blocker such as label:swords_missing_core_metric:strict_c_p@1.

summary.description: Family-specific extracted values used for the semantic decision. For issue #66, recognized families also record the verified Pari converter chain (converter protocol id/version/contract hash, converter source SHA-256, conversion identity, and coverage) so an official score is never promotion-comparable without a reconstructable conversion identity.
